annotations.text: Direction A — toolbar tabs after the traffic lights. Home is the default page on open. All-green is the steady 'it's working' state.
Dark palette — same layout, semantic colour swap only. Text at white 92% matches the overlay.
First launch only; later launches go silent to the tray. The permission-REQUEST flow logic is #47 / #89 / #88 — this is only the window state a fresh install opens to.
One scrolling page, macOS System Settings grouping. Startup (#135) and Microphone (#137) shown as designed-for slots; Vocabulary (#16) deliberately absent.
Direction B — a 176px sidebar instead of toolbar tabs, with Quit pinned to the bottom. Open question from the map: a sidebar for two items may be heavy. Pick A or B before #212.
Tokens extend the push-to-talk overlay (system-blue accent, radii, SF). Solid window; vibrancy only on the 52px toolbar strip.
